headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCorrectedRetryCode_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (start : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (h k : ℕ)
      (fallback : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c) (R : ℕ),
      0 < Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedWordWidth r c U L h k →
        ∀ (word : Fin (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedRetryWordWidth r c U L h k R) → Bool),
          Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawCorrectedRetryCode (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L
              (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑start) h k
              (OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode ↑fallback) R (List.ofFn word) =
            OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode
              ↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalCorrectedRetryWord r c U L hr hc start h k fallback R word)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawPositiveReferenceWordCode_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j)
  (hb : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveTraceBranch xs ys = Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.TraceInputBranch.reference)
  (t : ℕ) (word : Fin (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveReferenceWordWidth xs ys t) → Bool),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawPositiveReferenceWordCode xs ys htotal t (List.ofFn word) =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode
      ↑(Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.positiveReferenceWord xs ys htotal hb t word)

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawHybridWordWidth_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j) (t : ℕ),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawHybridWordWidth xs ys t = (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.hybridSampler xs ys htotal t).fst

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawHybridSamplerCode_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List ℕ)
  (htotal : ∑ i, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin xs i = ∑ j, Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.listMargin ys j) (t : ℕ)
  (word : Fin (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.hybridSampler xs ys htotal t).fst → Bool),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawHybridSamplerCode xs ys t (List.ofFn word) =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode ↑((Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.hybridSampler xs ys htotal t).snd word)
